scope: Physical converter installation; not electrical setup or complete robot instructions

frames.carrier: Right-handed; X along 70 mm edge, Y along 50 mm edge, +Z toward component side; underside Z=0 in present CAD. A1 bottom-right, X18 top-left in top view.
frames.converter: Pinned STEP datum: IN+ (0,0,0), IN- (0,-17.78,0), OUT+ (40.64,0,0), OUT- (40.64,-17.78,0); Z=0 nominal PCB underside.
frames.assembly_transform: Resolve CandidateModule native placement from snapshot; do not infer coordinates from legacy carrier object names.

instructor_dimensions.note: 0.5 mm installed insulated separation; capacitor top 11.5 mm from converter underside; roughly 1 mm screw protrusion; underside solder typically 1 mm, not a maximum.

step_semantics: Apply after state deltas in dependency order to initial_state. before contains required state values. Starting states must be reconstructed for arbitrary step navigation; these events are not an executable motion system.

steps.instruction: Insert the four short pin ends from beneath the converter until their black plastic spacers sit against its underside.
steps.inspection: Converter underside and side; highlight all four corner terminals.

steps.instruction: Solder each short pin end on the converter's top face.
steps.inspection: Top-side close-up; reveal solder only at this step.

steps.instruction: Remove the four black plastic spacers with pliers, leaving the soldered metal pins in place.
steps.inspection: Underside/side; distinguish removable plastic from retained metal.

steps.instruction: Apply the first insulating tape layer under the converter, keeping the corner terminal pads exposed.
steps.inspection: Underside; layer footprint remains to be authored.

steps.instruction: Add the second layer of insulating tape.
Add the third layer, keeping the four terminal pads exposed.
steps.inspection: Underside and edge; do not imply measured individual layer thickness.

steps.instruction: Insert the long pin ends into the carrier: OUT− V1, OUT+ O1, IN− V17, IN+ O17. Seat the insulated converter approximately 0.5 mm above the carrier top.
steps.inspection: Top to confirm addresses, then side to inspect the insulated separation.

steps.instruction: Clip all four pin ends flush with the carrier underside.
steps.inspection: Underside close-up; show clipping as a shape change, not shortened-pin translation.

steps.instruction: Solder the four carrier connections, filling the holes around the clipped pins.
steps.inspection: Underside and side: metal ends flush, solder mounds typically about 1 mm below the carrier.

authoring_rule: Preserve measured/report/photo/assumption status. Keep native CAD authoritative. Never present unknown intermediate geometry or illustrative solder profiles as measured facts.
